title: Student Survey Advisory Group Member
bio: Meley Ghermay is a first-year at Harvard College studying Human Developmental & Regenerative Biology with a secondary in Global Health & Health Policy. Outside of the Dean of Students Survey Advisory Group, she is the Co-Chair of the Harvard Undergraduate Association's First-Year Team, an Analyst for the Harvard Undergraduate Consulting Group, and on the Leadership Team of Harvard UNICEF. She is interested in global health, science, and community impact, and is excited to help strengthen how student feedback is used to improve the Harvard experience.
